# Merge tiers by changed path. Read by scripts/tier.py; every workflow that needs a PR's
# tier asks that script, and nothing trusts a label.
#
# A PR's tier is the strictest one any of its files falls in:
#   solver - gated, and the "Solver review" status needs the owner's review marker
#   gated  - waits for the owner to merge
#   auto   - everything else; merged by .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml once every
#            required check is green
# [heavy] is not a tier: a PR touching any of its paths (or any solver path) runs the heavy
# drag matrix in solver-bar.yml. It is broader than [solver] on purpose: the document model
# and the editor feed every drag, so they are tested by the matrix without each needing a
# separate review.
#
# Patterns are matched against repo-relative paths with forward slashes. `**` matches any
# number of directories (including none), `*` anything within one path segment.
# This file is itself gated (.github/**), so a PR can't loosen its own tier.

[solver]
# The solver, its tolerance and relation definitions, and the editor's drag and solve paths.
crates/drift-solver/**
crates/drift-core/src/constraint.rs
crates/drift-core/src/tolerance.rs
crates/drift-edit/src/drag_props.rs
crates/drift-edit/src/drag_props/**
crates/drift-edit/src/editor/drag.rs
crates/drift-edit/src/editor/drag_speed_tests.rs
crates/drift-edit/src/editor/solve.rs
crates/drift-edit/src/editor/kept_shapes_tests.rs
crates/drift-edit/src/editor/active_tests.rs
scripts/solver-bar/**

[gated]
# File format, save/load, recovery, import and export.
crates/drift-io/**
docs/file-format.md
crates/drift-app/src/output.rs
crates/drift-app/src/app/import_ui.rs
crates/drift-app/src/app/recovery.rs
crates/drift-app/src/app/document.rs
# The AI link (reads and writes files, serves a local connection) and the updater.
apps/mcp/**
crates/drift-app/src/agent/**
crates/drift-app/src/update/**
# Dependencies, versions and releases.
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
**/Cargo.toml
scripts/package-*
LICENSE.md
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
# CI and the process itself.
.github/**
.claude/**
CLAUDE.md
WORKFLOW.md
scripts/tier.py

scripts/auto_merge.py
scripts/protect-main.ps1
scripts/tests/**

[heavy]
# What the heavy drag matrix watched before tiers existed.
crates/drift-core/**
